reviews.text: Oh my gosh, like, let me totally spill the tea about Visca's Earth Conquest! So, like, when I first laid eyes on it, I was all like, "Hmm, a $4 game, what could it be?" But oh my stars, was I in for the cutest surprise ever! This game is legit one of the sweetest finds in the under $6 gaming universe! It's giving me major Flash vibes, you know? I've been on this quest lately to uncover games that totally scream Flash Era, and honey, Visca's Earth Conquest totally steals the spotlight! Sure, there are other games out there with growth mechanics like Smasher and the Will o' the Thiccs (adorbs name, right?), but let me tell you, Visca's is a whole new level of adorable! At first glance, you might think it's, like, super tiny, but oh my goodness, it's like a treasure trove of cuteness waiting to be discovered! This game totally messes with your mind in the most delightful way possible! Like, perspective-based gameplay? Sign me up, girl! My Curator Group: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/Curlyxxx Seriously, I'm giving Visca's Earth Conquest the highest grade ever, like S+ level cuteness! It's like finding the most perfect cupcake in a sea of, like, regular cupcakes. So worth it!

red-headed robot woman grows huge, punches, stomps, and vaporizes humanity you start tiny then become colossal. it's a bit like katamari if it was 2D, had a big open level, and instead of rolling things up you punched them into little egg-like pellets. and the army shot at u. also visca gets round and thick and makes stompy noises as she grows huge. boom boom boom. i didn't even realize how curvy she was getting until i was destroying the military and suddenly thought "oh, she's not really fitting into that outfit anymore." very nice progressive growth touch. overall this game is clearly a labor of love and honestly really fun even if you're not into the giantess growth / kink stuff. 10/10 would punch the earth again.

A fun game about a rouge AI hellbent on destroying the world through her little goober she creates. the gameplay is fun, go around and destroy objects and people to allow your character to grow bigger and bigger. The end goal is fun to get too, and there is replay value in the game, along with some challenging achievements. it took me around 5 hours to 100% the game, but i think it was worth, and i look forward to seeing what else Visca has in store in the future :3c
